verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs exist: an AGENTS.md at the repo root documents the CLI command surface (add, list, update, init, experimental_sync, lockfile restore), and the Agent Skills specification is published as raw markdown at agentskills.io/specification.md, so an agent can be pointed at clean machine-readable docs. However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt file, and a probe for a markdown docs variant returned HTTP 404. missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, evidence that skills.sh itself serves agent-oriented or markdown docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation of agents consuming these docs.
